research_analysis.exact_observed_hook: "I'm either at work, going to work, coming from work, getting ready for work, getting some sleep for work, or thinking about not wanting to go to work." (the entire audio is this one sentence)
research_analysis.visual_hook: Selfie close-up of a young man with a white earbud and a blue polo under a covered wooden patio, white text at the top of the frame.
research_analysis.narrative_structure: One continuous sentence, delivered deadpan to a selfie camera in 8 seconds. The sentence is a list that repeats one word and ends on a twist item. Captions mirror the words in two blocks. No cuts, loops.
research_analysis.viral_mechanism: A single-breath list builds rhythm through repetition, and the last item breaks the pattern with the honest version. It is short enough to finish before the viewer decides to scroll, and the loop restarts the sentence.
research_analysis.observed_evidence: 14.8M views, 27.8x a 533.1K median, 69.8K followers, 8 seconds, 0 cuts, loops, no CTA. The research pass found the same wording from two other creators at 4.5M and 1.2M, so the line is a circulating bit rather than one creator's original.
research_analysis.performance_hypothesis: Hypothesis: the views come from completion and loops on an 8-second clip plus sends to coworkers. Because the same sentence worked for three creators, the structure (one sentence, one repeated element, twist last) carries the result more than the performer does.
research_analysis.why_this_format_fits_alex: Under 10 seconds, one take, deadpan, readable with sound off: the same shape as Central Park (13.5M) and the travel hack (3.6M). The content of the sentence describes his actual job, which the current feed never does.
research_analysis.originality_changes: Borrowed: one-sentence deadpan list with a twist final item, captions mirroring speech, loop. New: every word. The list is an org chart of a one-person content business instead of a work-schedule complaint, and the twist is his mom.

creative_confidence.score_type: Subjective production-priority score, not predicted viral probability
creative_confidence.rationale: The cheapest script in the batch to shoot and the structure worked for three separate creators. It is spoken, unlike his two silent hits, but captions make it sound-off readable.
uncertainties: The reference line is a circulating bit; an original sentence may not carry the same familiarity.
Deadpan has to be exact. Any smile reads as trying.
Reference creator had a 533K median, so the 27.8x multiple is weaker evidence than the small-account outliers.
